title: filenode-client: filenode_set_conditional
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C10. Crates: jmap-filenode-client. Size: S.

Implement docs/design/conditional.md §8 FileNode binding (decision 8, docs/design/DECISIONS.md; conditional-02 §5). New fn filenode_set_conditional built on base-client SetCall/set_call with using = USING_FILENODE + conditional URI; FileNodeSetParams and filenode_set unchanged (struct not non_exhaustive). Acceptance: wiremock tests sending example 5.1 and 5.8 request shapes and decoding stateMismatch(failed) and atomicFailure via ConditionalError; public-api additions only.
